Peripheral Neuropathy

# Medbridge ideas

@louwClinicalApplicationEasing

- Can become super sensitive/painful
- Map in brain decreases /shrinks
- Case series: 
    - Taking peripheral neuropathy patient’s shoes off, and do discrimination techniques to calm system
- Sharp /dull
- 1-2 points
- Stand on tile “this is tile, it is cold, I can feel it”
- Stand on surfaces, switch them around, eyes close and feel it
- Maps shrink/sharper
- They improved sensation and pain
- Paperclips bent to 3cm,4cm,5cm
- Took paper clip and 2 points 1 point starting at 5 , if accurate, go to 4. 
- Clinical tool to improve discrimination
- Fall risk can improve with just this according to one study on neuropathy
